resources.string: Disable ads
Removes ads and the ad consent form, and keeps the ad SDKs from starting.
Fix /s/ links
Opens Reddit share links (/s/) as the post they point to, from the app and from other apps.
Fix galleries
Restores Reddit gallery and inline video lookup and uses available previews for failed gallery images.
Fix Imgur
Loads Imgur albums and covers through the Imgur API and opens titled album links.
Fix load more comments
Fixes \"load more comments\" not loading further comments.
Fix markdown links
Shows markdown links that Reddit leaves as raw text, such as links to u/name, as links.
Fix media links
Opens reddit.com/media links as the Reddit-hosted image they wrap.
Fix Redgifs
Opens RedGIFs video links in the public embedded player inside rif’s browser.
Fix YouTube player
Fixes the built-in YouTube player, which showed a black screen and error code 0.
Keep typed text in view
Keeps the line being typed in view when writing a long reply.
Imgur client ID
Overrides the Imgur registration bundled with this app. Use a client ID you are authorized to use.
Hide retired service controls

Makes the ads checkbox control ad placement independently of Cards, native albums and folder themes. Hides disabled Synccit and new-post notification settings, new subscriptions, and the remote theme catalog.
Show ads
Shows ads in feeds and image albums when rif allows them. Restart rif to refresh open screens.
Spoof client
Uses your own Reddit OAuth registration when all three options are set. Leaves the app’s configuration in place when they are blank.
OAuth client ID
The public client ID from your own Reddit installed-app registration.
Redirect URI
The callback URI registered for that Reddit client.
User-Agent
A descriptive User-Agent that identifies your app and its operator.
